description: Fetches trending tokens (GMGN sniper data), filters honeypots and rugs, runs composite_signal on each, and returns ranked results by signal score. Use this to discover the best current opportunities. 0.05 USDC per call via x402.

paymentProof.description: Payment proof: USDC tx hash on Polygon or Base (0x...) or Solana tx signature. Omit on the first call to receive the 402 payment instructions, pay, then call again with the proof.
